subject: Bone Marrow Fat Secretes Lipids That Drive Cellular Senescence—and a Targeted Framework May Stop It
script: From Agewell Brief: Bone Marrow Fat Secretes Lipids That Drive Cellular Senescence—and a Targeted Framework May Stop It. New research reveals that bone marrow adipocytes flood neighboring cells with lipids, triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and senescence. A polycation-loaded framework interrupts this lipid crosstalk, restoring osteogenesis. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
